name: Oliver Berglund
source:
A short man who works in a nail salon and rents a room in a multi-room house.
In his free time he is engaged in the creation of weapons in the garage. But there is no forge there, which sometimes raises questions from those who do not know how he forges his products. Oliver loves heavy hammers and maces, but can also make short daggers and even firearms. Despite his sociability and gentle nature, nothing is known about Berglund's past, which is why local dormitories have room for theories, from the most prosaic to the insane. But you can be sure that Oliver is the most reliable friend who will always help out in difficult times.
